explication: Beats is a family of lightweight operational-data shippers built on libbeat: each Beat gathers a different kind of data, forms events, and publishes them toward Elasticsearch or Logstash. The graph shows the shared event path and the distinct collection stages documented in the README. The file tree supports representative collection and pipeline paths, but not every Beat’s wiring was sampled, so subsystem links are limited to the documented product workflow.
